title: Misleading charges and unhelpful support
body:
I initially intended to purchase only the 7-day trial for Habio via the app, which was supposed to cost $5.49. However, while finalizing my purchase, my account was unexpectedly charged two additional amounts of $29.99 each, totaling $59.98—without my consent. 

This was not my intention, and I immediately canceled the subscriptions. When I reached out to their support team, they simply referred me to their Money-Back Policy and refused to issue a refund. It’s frustrating and feels like a blatant scam. Be cautious if you decide to use this app.
author: Masoumah

title: Fraude ! Don’t buy this app . You can’t cancel your subscription
body: Don’t trust this app! I took a subscription for 5 days to try it out . I canceled my subscription before the renewal on time. Still they took €29,99 from my credit card . When I write them about this help centrum writes: we like to hear from you why you leave .But they don’t write back that I canceled it. I canceled it already before renewal . I send them 4 mails at date 26 th April to cancel before April 30th . And no answers . And the app is very chaotic as an adhd it didn’t help me

title: Useless
body:
Such a useless app. Paid for a trial period for a week and found very little use. Better off using the reminders app to create lists and goals for yourself. There’s barely any reading material on there so you’re not realy learning anything, just tick off and track your set goals. 
It mentions in the app, if you pay, you’re more likely to check in and do it, however seeing how little it offers, comes across as a bit of a scam 🙂

title: DO NOT purchase anything
body: I made an in-app purchase of a book and was charged twice. I sent all the receipts and proof that it was a double charge. I have not yet downloaded the e-books. title: This App is a SCAM
body:
It will allow you a trial for 1euro for couple days, but when trying to cancel the errors will come. Customer service will respond once with “oh why are you leaving us” but will never answer the actual question on how to cancel or respond to any follow up emails. STAY AWAY!

I am working on reporting it to the EU Customer Rights Regulator as well as contacting my credit card to flag a fraud.

title: Made an account, cannot log in
body: Im getting many ads by this app so I figured to give it a go. Of course im not buying a subscription instantly just from the website, so I downloaded the app and signed up. It doesn’t let me log into my account, even after getting mails to reset my password. I guess we’ll never find out whether this app is any good.
author: jesuisjulia

title: Abusive Terms - No refund - Paid Trial - No right of withdrawal
body:
If I could give less than 1 star, I would.  ABUSIVE billing terms. 

You pay 29,90 Euros for one month of subscription, and according to their terms/conditions, you have no right to a refund, even if you cancel within the trial period, they must be notified, at least, 24hours before the trial expires. Factually their 3 days trial for 1,00 Euro is actually a 2 two days trial, that will cost you much more than what they advertise. 

EU residents: They undermine your consumer rights in their “100% money policy guarantee policy” by revoking your right to withdraw within 14 days as dictated under EU law. 

Do not install this app, that’s the best advice I can give. Their support staff is unhelpful and take days to answer one single email.
